title: Gitartha — Bhagavad Gita chapter file
description: Structure of one chapters/chapter_NN.json file. Validates STRUCTURE only: empty strings are allowed so drafts can be saved. Completeness, cross-references (unique verse ids/numbers, id/reference consistency, source ids) and review readiness are checked by tool/validate_gita_content.dart, because JSON Schema cannot express them.

schema_version.description: Version of this content format. Files in this version must say exactly 1.0.0.

verses.description: Verses of this chapter, ordered by verse_number. May be empty while authoring. Uniqueness of id and verse_number is enforced by the validator script.

text.description: Free text. Empty string = not written yet. If not empty, it must not start or end with whitespace.

reviewStatus.description: Editorial workflow state, set by people (not computed). draft = being written; in_review = submitted for review; approved = verified and approved for publication. Not imported into Supabase as a column.

contentSection.description: A verse field that a source can be attributed to. Must match the allowed values of shloka_source_attributions.content_section in Supabase.

source_id.description: id of an entry in sources/sources.json.

id.description: Chapter number. Must match the file name (chapter_NN.json).

key_topics.description: Ordered list of key topics. Empty while not yet written.

id.description: Stable human-readable id: chapter_NN_verse_NNN (zero-padded). Must agree with the chapter id and verse_number.

reference.description: "chapter.verse" without padding, e.g. 1.41. Must agree with the chapter id and verse_number.

hindi_meaning_note.description: Optional wording note shown after the Hindi meaning. Never part of the translation itself.

source_attributions.description: Verified sources for individual sections of this verse. Only add an entry when the source is known and verified.
